purpose: Closing the income statement into the result for the year (00071500 Jahresergebnis) and any final statutory close entries.
timing: Within 15 working days of the fiscal year end
population_rule: Every Kestrel entity, every closed fiscal year, without exception.
notes: The only special period that is always populated. Aurora and Sable close directly to retained earnings in period 12; Kestrel uses a dedicated result account and a dedicated period, which is why the group chart carries 320200 alongside 320100.

purpose: Reclassifications arising from the statutory audit: misclassified accruals, professional fees recorded against the wrong category, receivables presented gross that should be net.
timing: Two to four months after the fiscal year end
population_rule: Only where an audit finding actually arose. Two of the four Kestrel entities in a given year, and not the same two each year. Not populated for a year that is not yet audited.
notes: Audit adjustments here are reclassifications, not restatements of the result. The group's reported result IS the approved anchor, so the generated ledger is the audited outturn; modelling a pre-audit ledger that differed would require an unaudited scenario, which is out of scope.

purpose: True-up of the current tax charge and its balance sheet presentation on filing the corporate tax return: reallocation between corporate income tax and other taxes, and between the current tax and trade tax lines.
timing: Six to nine months after the fiscal year end, on filing
population_rule: Every Kestrel entity for every filed fiscal year. FY2026 is not yet filed, so no period 15 exists for it.
notes: German entities file corporate income tax and trade tax separately, and the split between them is only settled on filing. The total tax charge is unchanged; its allocation is not.

name_english: Local GAAP to group reporting adjustments
purpose: Aligning locally-measured provisions to group accounting policy: warranty, restructuring and other provisions measured under HGB are reclassified to the group's provision categories.
posted_by: Group financial control with local finance
population_rule: Kestrel entities carrying a material provision balance. Not every entity every year.
notes: This is the local-to-group bridge that a German subsidiary books in its own ledger before submitting to the group. It does not include the operating lease right-of-use asset, which the Kestrel entities do not recognise locally at all and which Phase 3 raises as a staging top-side entry.
